objective: Study recurrent ranking of checked Lean tactics, independent fast learning, and loop-message effects.
context: Small reference models rank pre-collected tactics with independent Lean receipts. A uses a shared cell and eight typed roles; B has prelude, tied middle blocks, message bank and coda. Only full-goal closure is positive for this task.

steps.name: Encode goal and candidates
steps.description: Specify byte-local and typed latent inputs.

steps.name: Process recurrent state
steps.description: Describe shared blocks and message recurrence.

steps.name: Adapt on support feedback
steps.description: Derive the independent CPU fast-head update and controls.

steps.name: Rank tactics
steps.description: Define permitted evidence, candidate scores and exit rule.

steps.name: Evaluate held-out goals
steps.description: Explain receipt scope and matched message or depth comparisons.

specific_questions.prompt: Explain the difference between an accepted tactic that leaves subgoals and a full-goal-closing tactic. Propose a checkable scoring contract for each.
Derive a small message-bank recurrence and construct normal, zero and rolled-message controls.
Design a comparison that separates message effects from extra parameter and compute budget.
Construct a numerical fast logistic head support update and its held-out prediction; describe the retrieval-only baseline.

native_verifier: Existing PPT checked-menu receipt scorer; independent Lean kernel needed for new proof claims.
